name: Down Right
purpose: The wingback runs inside off the same backfield action. When their end starts flying upfield to beat the sweep, this hits right behind him.

LE.rule: Block back and cut off pursuit. You are the last one to the ball.

LT.rule: Block back. Take the first defender on or inside you. Nobody crosses your face.

LG.rule: Block back. Take the first defender on or inside you. Nobody crosses your face.

C.rule: Block the man over you. If nobody is over you, help to the backside.

RG.rule: Block the man over you and drive him inside. You are the inside wall.

RT.rule: Block the man over you and drive him outside. You are the outside wall.

RE.rule: Block down inside. Let their end run himself upfield — he is not yours.

WB.rule: Step inside and take the handoff at three yards. Run through the gap between our guard and tackle. Straight ahead, no bouncing.

QB.rule: Turn and hand the ball to the wingback coming underneath, then carry out the sweep fake the other way.

FB.rule: Run the trap path and get hit. Same as always.

HB.rule: Run the sweep path away and sell it.

coaching_points: This is the answer to an end who crashes upfield. Watch him for a series before you call it.
The wingback runs north the moment he has the ball. His instinct will be to bounce outside — coach it out of him.
